messages:
mara (support): Heads-up: ACME reported that their division sub-org shows zero rows in the analytics dashboard for the last 90 days. They say API calls for that org_id return 403.

acme-customer (external): confirmed — when we call /v1/metrics?org_id=acme:west-sub our token returns 403. Other orgs fine. Started after we changed retention policy a week ago.

mara (support): Repro steps from customer: 1) Use org-scoped API key for parent org 2) GET /v1/metrics?org_id=acme:west-sub&range=90d 3) Response is HTTP 403 JSON: 
```
{"error":"forbidden","message":"access denied to requested org"}
```

mara (support): They provided example request id: req_0a1b2c3d and sample time window.

devin (eng-analytics): @mara thanks. Can you paste the full curl (headers redacted) and the request id? Also, do parent org users see the dashboard for the child org in Console?

mara (support): Curl (redacted):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/metrics?org_id=acme:west-sub&range=90d"
```
Request id: req_0a1b2c3d (2026-11-02T14:12:03Z)
Parent org DOES see aggregate numbers, but when you switch to the sub-org scope the charts are empty.

raj (sre): I'll check the permission-service logs for req_0a1b2c3d and also the retention TTL overrides. Sometimes linked orgs get a different retention row.

metrics-bot: permission-service: request=req_0a1b2c3d status=403 reason=org_not_permitted user=parent:admin rule=org_scope_check

devin (eng-analytics): I reproduced locally with a fixture key and got the same 403. Looking at authz we query "org_lookup" table to map org_id -> canonical_org. For linked sub-orgs we recently changed the retention TTL to write under canonical_org_id, but the authz lookup still queries by external_org_id. Potential mismatch.

cleo (product): Did we roll any RBAC changes last week? This came after a retention policy change from support request ACME-RET-112.

devin (eng-analytics): Not an RBAC policy change, it seems. Reproduction trace:
```
- permission-service: lookup external_org_id=acme:west-sub -> returns null (due to TTL row under canonical id)
- permission-service: denies -> 403
- metrics-service: returns 403 to client
```

devin (eng-analytics): The root cause: a retention migration wrote TTL entries keyed by canonical_org_id for linked orgs, while permission-service expects external_org_id to be present for org scoping. So when retention override prunes auxiliary mapping rows, permission lookup fails.

raj (sre): Created an alert and added a hotfix rollback plan. I'm seeing approx 12 customers with linked-suborgs showing similar gaps.

mara (support): ACME is asking for ETA — they said business dashboards are blocked.

devin (eng-analytics): I have a small fix in a branch that adds a fallback: if external_org_id lookup fails, try canonical_org_id mapping and populate cache. PR #2789. Will push a small patch to permission-service and a 1-hr canary.

metrics-bot: deploy-bot: started canary deploy permission-service@fix/2789 -> canary-1 (env: prod, zone: us-west-2)

raj (sre): Rolling canary now. Watch for 403 rate drop for the affected orgs. I also reverted the retention migration write that removed external_org_id rows for linked orgs.

mara (support): ACME confirms they can now GET the metrics and the Console shows historic rows repopulating. Customer: "Thanks, data came back for the last 90 days." :relieved:

cleo (product): Can we add an automated test to retention migration not to drop external_org_id mapping? Also add a regression test in authz for fallback behavior.

devin (eng-analytics): Agreed. I'll add two tests and a small doc note for retention-runbooks.

mara (support): Closing the support escalation — customer confirmed restored. I'll file a follow-up CS ticket for proactive outreach to affected customers.

raj (sre): Postmortem: retention migration wrote TTL rows under canonical_org_id only -> authz lookup by external_org_id returned null -> permission-service returned 403 for linked sub-orgs -> metrics API surfaced empty charts. Mitigation: immediate rollback of migration write + permission-service fallback + tests + runbook.

cleo (product): Good triage. Please @everyone add the RCA to the incidents channel and include impacted org list so CS can notify.

mara (support): Noted. I'll attach impacted org list and send customer comms template.

metrics-bot: incident-bot: incident=open id=INC-20261102-042 title="Linked-org retention mapping caused 403 on metrics API" severity=2 assigned=eng-analytics,eng-sre,product
